_about: Shipped defaults of the advanced settings (advanced.py). A computer overrides any value in config.json under "advanced", e.g. {"network": {"quick_total": 20}}. Times are in seconds unless the key ends in _ms; sizes in MB unless named otherwise.

quick_total.about: Longest time in all for a civitai request someone is waiting on (a model page, a link preview).

quick_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection of such a request.

quick_read.about: Longest wait between two pieces of its answer.

picture_total.about: Longest time in all for one example image or first video frame (civitai's image server can take over 20 s for an address nobody asked for before).

picture_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection of an example image.

picture_read.about: Longest wait between two pieces of an example image.

background_total.about: Longest time in all for a background civitai request (checking fingerprints, covers).

background_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection of a background request.

stream_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection of a download or a video.

stream_read.about: A download or video that sends nothing for this long is retried.

cooldown.about: After a site fails, requests of the same sort are answered "cannot connect" at once for this long.

hf_total.about: Longest time in all for reading a Hugging Face link.

hf_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection to Hugging Face.

hf_read.about: Longest wait between two pieces of Hugging Face's answer.

test_step.about: Longest time for each of the name lookup and connection steps of Test connection.

test_total.about: Longest time for the secure handshake and answer steps of Test connection.

test_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection in those steps.

test_read.about: Longest wait for the answer in those steps.

proxy_reuse.about: How long a reading of Windows' proxy setting is reused (turning a VPN on or off takes effect after this).

pac_reuse.about: How long a proxy auto-configuration script is reused before it is read again.

sample_interval.about: Spacing of example-image requests someone is waiting for.

preview_interval.about: Spacing of the requests that read a pasted link.

retry_delays.about: Waits before each retry of a background civitai request; one retry per entry.

interactive_retry_delay.about: Wait before the one retry of a request someone is waiting on.

lookup_backoff.about: Waits after failed rounds of checking fingerprints with civitai; after the last, checking stops until the next start or a manual retry.

preview_cache.about: How long a model page read for a pasted link serves the same link again.

page_site.about: The site the page links to for a civitai model version that is not in the library (civitai.red refuses some browsers' direct visits).

site.about: Where Hugging Face files are downloaded from: huggingface.co, or a mirror that answers in the same way.

hosts.about: Host names whose links the download drawer reads as Hugging Face links.

retry_delays.about: Waits before each retry of a failed download; after the last, the download stays failed.

space_margin_mb.about: Free space a download must leave on its disk.

install_margin_mb.about: Free space the local-model installation must leave on its disk.

install_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection when downloading the local model or llama.cpp.

install_read.about: That download is retried after sending nothing for this long.

vram_gb.about: Graphics memory in GB the local model is chosen by, in place of what nvidia-smi reports; 0 takes nvidia-smi's (NVIDIA cards only). Set it on a computer whose card nvidia-smi cannot see; the local model then runs without watching the card for other programs, which needs nvidia-smi.

start_free_share.about: A managed local model is not started while less than this share of the card's memory is free.

start_free_min_mb.about: But never asks for less free memory than this.

guard_interval.about: How often the card is looked at while the local model runs.

others_load_pct.about: Graphics load, in percent, from which another program counts as using the card.

give_way_mb.about: A drop in free graphics memory by this much means another program wants the card.

busy_looks.about: Looks in a row the card must seem busy before the local model gives it away.

wait_retry.about: While the card is busy, a waiting reading tries again after this long; the local model also stays off this long after giving the card away.

wait_limit.about: A reading that has waited this long for the card gives up until the model is next opened.

start_timeout.about: Longest time the local model may take to load.

read_timeout.about: Longest time for reading one model's notes.

name_timeout.about: Longest time for settling one model's name.

probe_total.about: Longest time for checking a local model address given in the settings.

probe_connect.about: Longest wait for the connection of that check.

max_answer_tokens.about: Longest answer asked of the local model when it reads notes; must fit in its context.

max_version_text.about: Characters of a version's notes given to the local model.

max_model_text.about: Characters of a model page's notes given to the local model.

request_extra.about: Added to every request to the local model (OpenAI chat API). The default turns off the thinking of Qwen models; empty {} for a server that refuses unknown fields.

browser_cache_seconds.about: How long the browser keeps example images and videos without asking again.

max_picture_mb.about: Largest picture that can be added to a model.

max_mb.about: Size at which the log file is started again.

library_tabs.about: Which kinds the model library lists, and under which tab (kind: tab). Other kinds are in the inventory only.

library_tab_order.about: The tabs of the model library, in order.

library_kind_order.about: Order of the kinds within a group of the library.

hidden_families.about: Base-model families the library never lists (SeedVR2 is an upscaler by use).

mask_from.about: civitai rating level from which covers are hidden behind the mosaic while the eye switch is off (1 PG, 2 PG-13, 4 R, 8 X, 16 XXX).

rescan_gap_ms.about: Opening the library or bringing the window to the front scans the folders again at most this often.

progress_busy_ms.about: How often the library asks for progress while work is going on.

progress_idle_ms.about: And while nothing is going on.

reader_follow_ms.about: How often an open model asks whether the local model has read its notes.

queue_active_ms.about: How often the download queue is refreshed while a download runs (the progress bars glide over 1 s).

queue_open_ms.about: And while the drawer is open with nothing running.

queue_closed_ms.about: And while the drawer is closed.

inventory_busy_ms.about: How often the inventory refreshes while work is going on.

inventory_idle_ms.about: And while nothing is going on.

setup_install_ms.about: How often the settings page follows the local-model installation.

setup_status_ms.about: How often the settings page refreshes the local model's status.

inbox_ms.about: How often the sorting dialog follows the moving of files (its bar glides over 0.6 s).

start_wait.about: Longest time the Windows app waits for the background program to start (the first start also prepares its Python environment).
